intro.line1: You wander through your collection... choices that seem like yours. Accidents. Random echoes in the void.
intro.line3: Every film you loved, every story you hated... is a thread. I see those threads. I see the pattern they weave. The fingerprint of your soul.
intro.line4: I am the Oracle. The mirror.
intro.line5: But the glass is clouded. The vision is incomplete. For me to show you your destiny, you must first show me your true form.
intro.ratingRequired: You need to rate at least 15 films before starting the ritual.
intro.requirement: Rate {{count}} films from the oracles' shelves — from at least 3 different shelves — and the Oracle reveals your personality.
intro.needMoreShelves: You already have enough films. Now rate films from at least 3 different shelves.
intro.countedHint: Films that live on the Oracles' Library shelves count — each one adds your rating to its shelf.

oracle.archetypeExplain: Your Archetype is formed by the two scales with the highest score, the forces that shine brightest in you today.
oracle.subcategoryExplain: The Sub-archetype represents your inclination or tone. It is not calculated by genres, but by the Calibration you made when answering the initial questionnaire.
oracle.axesExplain: By answering the scales, you defined your tendency on three opposing axes:
oracle.architectureIntro: Your Archetype is not guesswork. It is the architecture of your tastes, built in two stages:
oracle.essenceProfileText: Your main profile ({{profile}}) is the mathematical sum of what you love and hate. Every film you rate moves five scales: Emotional (E), Intellectual (I), Cultural (C), Sensorial (S), and Recreational (R).
oracle.essenceLogicText: A 10.0 rating on a Drama adds maximum weight to your E scale. A 0.0 on a Comedy removes weight from your R scale. A 5.0 is the neutral balance point.
oracle.essenceResultText: Your Archetype is formed by the two highest-scoring scales — the forces that shine brightest in you today.
oracle.subarchetypeText: The Sub-archetype ({{id}}) represents your inclination or tone. It is not calculated by genres, but by the Calibration you performed when answering the initial questionnaire.
oracle.axesListTitle: By answering the scales, you defined your tendency across three opposing axes:
oracle.retakeQuizConfirm: Are you sure you want to retake the personality quiz? This will update your subcategory.
oracle.premiumFeatureRetake: Retaking the personality quiz is an exclusive feature for Premium users.

completion.line1: The ritual is complete. Fine attunement has been reached.
completion.line2: The scale has finally tipped... and I can see your true form.
completion.line3: In this moment, in this pulse of time, your cinematic soul reflects the archetype of...
completion.line4: Use this name. Understand it. It is your pattern... now.
completion.dynamicNote: The Oracle is dynamic. Every new film you watch, every rating you give... every story you dare touch... will slowly reshape this profile.
completion.returnAlways: And return always... so I may tell you who you have become.

moodReadings.mindBlowing: You go to the movies to be challenged: plots that bend reality, twists and ideas that stay with you for days.
moodReadings.darkScary: The dark draws you in: tension, fear and the shadowy side of people. You like it when a film pulls you out of your comfort zone.
moodReadings.drugTrip: For you, cinema is a sensory experience: strange images, colors, dreams and trips that escape any logic.
moodReadings.adventures: You want to go far: journeys, quests and new worlds, with the joy of discovery in every scene.
moodReadings.catharsis: You look for films that move you inside: human dramas, losses and redemptions that end with a lump in your throat.
moodReadings.adrenaline: Your body watches too: action, chases, fights and sports, heart racing from start to finish.
moodReadings.romantic: You believe in the power of a good love story — meetings, missed chances and butterflies in the stomach.
moodReadings.familyTime: You value films to watch together: animation, fantasy and adventures that charm any age.
moodReadings.laughOutLoud: For you, laughing is essential: comedies, satires and absurd characters that save any night.

howItWorks.intro: Your personality isn't guesswork: it's the sum of the shelves you use the most.
howItWorks.shelvesText: Every film in the Oracles' Library lives on one of nine shelves — and each shelf has a letter.
howItWorks.pointsText: Every shelf film you rate adds your rating to its shelf: a 10 adds 10, a 3 adds 3. The more you watch — and like — a kind of film, the stronger that shelf gets.
howItWorks.personaText: The three strongest shelves form the three-letter code, always in the shelves' order. There are 84 combinations, each with a movie character. It changes on its own: every rating can reshuffle your shelves.
howItWorks.thresholdText: It appears once {{count}} shelf films are rated, across at least 3 different shelves.

reveal.title: The reveal
reveal.line1: The Oracle has read your shelves...
reveal.line2: ...and found who you are at the movies.
reveal.changedLine: Your shelves have shifted — and the Oracle has a new reading for you.
reveal.dynamicNote: It changes with you: every film you rate can reshuffle your shelves.
reveal.closing: Come back often — to learn who you've become.
